entities.title: Live index
entities.summary: Keeps one git work tree's file list current: which files git sees, the stat key and blob of each, and a log of what changed, from file-change notifications, reconciles and on-demand re-checks.
entities.purpose: Holds RootIndex, one per attached root path, with its change sources (FSEvents on macOS, FileSystemWatcher elsewhere) and the two records it keeps per file and per blob. It decides when a file must be analysed again; the analysis itself is done by src/Analysis/ through Engine.GetOrAddBlob.
boundaries: The SQLite store and the shared blob tables belong to src/ (Store.cs, Engine.cs); this folder reads and writes them only through Store and Engine.
git decides which files exist and which are ignored; the index never applies ignore rules itself.
The tools in src/Tools/ call Files, Freshen, Barrier, Sync, ChangesSince, Gen and WaitReady; they do not reach into the index's state.
